lead.head: Shenzhou-24 lifts off with Pakistan's first astronaut
lead.stand: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali becomes the first foreigner aboard Tiangong. The Long March-2F launched at 00:18 GMT and docked hours later; Ali stays 5–10 days, then returns aboard Shenzhou-23.
